cluster.window: Bites in the last 12 weeks: {from} to {to}

places.title: Where the bites happened
places.about: Place types from what patients said. A count under 5 shows as <5.

rounds.title: Seen on rounds
rounds.about: Dogs the team counted on its own rounds in these wards. They are counted separately from the bite-based share and are not mixed with it.

wards.title: Wards in this area
wards.caption: Wards in this area, counts only

worked.title: Wards the team covered
worked.about: Bites in the weeks before and after the team covered a ward. Too early and too few to say the work caused a change.
worked.caption: Wards the team covered, bites before and after
worked.none: No wards the team covered are recorded in this area

weekly.title: Bites each week
weekly.about: Counts only. A week under 5 reads <5 and a week held back so that it cannot be worked out from the others reads hidden: both are hatched, never drawn as a length. The newest week is not over yet, so it reads low.
weekly.legend: Hatched: under 5 or hidden. Dashed: the week is not over.
